name: credits_refused_is_never_retried
description: When the credit ledger refuses to hold credits for an agent run, the start answers 503 credits.refused. Any other 503 is retried; this one cannot change by repeating, so it is raised at once, as its own concept. Nothing ran and nothing was charged.

body.title: The credits ledger refused this
body.detail: The credits ledger refused to hold credits for this run.
